title: (fix) O3-5913: Wait for patient data deletions before reporting save success
body:

## Summary

Patient edits could report success while name, identifier, or person-attribute deletions were still running. The deletion paths discarded their promises, and attribute deletion also caught failures and only logged them. A failed cleanup could therefore leave stale patient data behind after the UI reported a successful save.

This change collects and awaits the name and identifier deletion requests. It also moves attribute deletion out of the synchronous patient-payload builder and into the asynchronous save flow. Deletion failures now reject the save through the existing error handling, and the patient update does not begin until the requested deletions complete.

Deferred-promise tests cover all three deletion types. They verify that the patient save remains pending while deletion is pending and does not run when deletion fails.
